connection_rules.rule: F998 has no documented MIDI capability. Keep all keyboard, controller, and synthesizer MIDI connections outside it.
Use the TEYUN A8 for XPS-30 and FM-1 line-level mixing. F998's documented role is mic/accompaniment/streaming and its input headroom and port topology are unverified for keyboard line outputs.

Do not connect XPS-30 or FM-1 directly at normal output level to the claimed accompaniment input until its physical label and headroom are verified. If tested, start at minimum source volume and use attenuation if clipping occurs.

Treat headset, earphone, and live-stream outputs as monitoring or consumer streaming feeds, not balanced PA outputs. Do not connect them directly to passive speakers or assume they are appropriate main live outputs.
Use the OTG/PC path on Ubuntu only after recording its capture/playback endpoint names and verifying feedback-free operation at low level.
